identity: An Arabic Wikipedia encyclopedia article on association football (كرة القدم): expository MSA in the third person, dense with dates, institutions and transliterated proper names, organised as a lead section plus two titled sections whose headings stand alone between <NL> tokens (أصل التسمية at 232-233, تاريخ كرة القدم at 320-322). The prose is a close, sentence-by-sentence translation of the English Wikipedia article, so clause order and connectives track the English original closely.
law: The sentence unit is one complete predication plus everything subordinated to it. A boundary falls only where a predication closes and a new one opens with its own full subject or fronted adverbial. The connective و is NEUTRAL, not a blocker: و + a fresh full subject and a new claim opens a sentence (وكلتا اللعبتين, وهناك العديد, وهناك أيضا, وكانت المدرسة الوحيدة, وسرعان ما), whereas و + an anaphoric pronoun or a verb inheriting the previous subject continues it (وهي, وقد وضعت خلالها, وأعلنت, وتلعب فيها). Asyndetic juxtaposition of two finite predications, with no connective at all, is the strongest boundary signal available once punctuation is stripped and accounts for most breaks here. Relative pronouns (الذي, التي, والتي, والذي), the subordinators غير أن and بل, colon-style enumerations (الأولى هي ... والثانية هي), and ف- resumptive links (فلذلك, فتكون, فقد) all bind clauses INTO a sentence and never open one. Section headings are their own units, and the <NL>-adjacent and final positions are fixed.
reasoning: First I tested a strict law that only asyndetic clauses may open sentences. It fails at 324-399, where it would force a single 76-token sentence while the text plainly makes four statements (two ancient European games; both resembled mob football; there are old kicking contests such as cuju; there are also similar non-competitive games such as kemari and woggabaliri). So و must be allowed to open sentences, and the test shifts to whether the و-clause carries its own new subject. Site 157 (الفيفا | تنظم): this could be an appositive relative, but the Arabic supplies NO relative pronoun - bare الفيفا followed by تنظم reads as clause-end plus a pro-dropped subject, so I break, med. Site 306 (وكندا | وفي دول أخرى): و-initial but a fronted PP with a new subject contrasting UK usage against elsewhere - break, med. Site 481 (شروسبري | غير أن): NO break - غير أن is adversative-subordinating and renders a coordinated but-clause, so it binds to وقد كتبت قوانين كامبردج. Site 648 (السابقة | الأولى هي): NO break - this is the enumeration of the two deleted draft rules, a colon list, and a colon is not a sentence terminator. Site 799 (ألكوك | وقد أخذت): NO break - founded by Alcock and contested by English clubs since 1872 is one predication chain about the same cup. Site 211 (والمهارة | وهي تتمثل): NO break - وهي is elaborative-anaphoric everywhere in this document (171, 335, 355, 867), so paragraph 173-230 is a single long sentence closing on the forced 230. Site 724 (واحدة | وقد شابهت): break, med - وقد here takes a fresh full subject هذه القوانين and a new comparison to Victorian rules football, unlike the anaphoric وقد وضعت خلالها at 614 which I leave joined. Site 810 (1872 | وكانت أول مباراة): break, med - the repetition of سنة 1872 then عام 1872 across the junction is incoherent inside one sentence. The hardest site is 988 vs 994: في العديد من الأنحاء من العالم can either close the television-audience clause or front the next one. I attach it FORWARD and break at 988 (الرياضات), because the preceding predication is already saturated by من بين جميع الرياضات, because the clumsy literal shape في العديد من الأنحاء من العالم reads as a rendering of a sentence-initial adverbial, and because fronted locative and temporal PPs before the verb are attested twice in this document (287 في عالم المتحدثين بالإنجليزية, 489 أثناء خمسينات القرن التاسع عشر). Note also that وفقا at 955 is the single word wafqan, not و + a clause, so 954 is an ordinary asyndetic break. Remaining breaks are asyndetic finite-predication junctions and are marked hi; و-initial breaks that depend on the new-subject test are marked med.
